source.description:
**Position Purpose**

The Senior Manager leads the global Advanced Manufacturing Technology (AMT) organization and converts long-range technical direction into an executable three-to-five-year portfolio of technology, automation, equipment, and factory-transformation initiatives.

The role owns people leadership, portfolio execution, global capital-process stewardship, strategic vendor and technical-equipment vendor portfolio management, deployment, adoption, and business results.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

Translate enterprise strategy and technical direction into an executable AMT roadmap.

Prioritize initiatives using business value, readiness, risk, capacity, and strategic alignment.

Drive results across functions, regions, and multiple levels.

**Global Capital Process Custodianship**

Serve as custodian of the global capital process, including standard work, governance, review cadence, documentation quality, portfolio transparency, and continuous improvement.

Develop and quality-review investment plans, business cases, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

Provide the Vice President portfolio analysis and recommendations supporting global capital strategy and prioritization.

Manage assigned capital and operating budgets and ensure financial adherence.

**Global Vendor and Technical Equipment Portfolio**

Lead strategic relationships with key global manufacturing-technology and equipment vendors.

Create and maintain the technical equipment vendor portfolio, including preferred capabilities, technology coverage, performance, quality, delivery, risk, capacity, lifecycle support, and regional applicability.

Lead supplier development, technical reviews, commercial alignment, long-term service strategies, and executive escalation.

Use global portfolio leverage to improve standardization, innovation access, total cost, delivery, and support.

**Technology Deployment and Results**

Lead programs from concept approval through industrialization, qualification, deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Establish accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and measurable outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers and ensure consistent execution across regions.

**Organization and Talent**

Lead, coach, and develop.

Build morale, productivity, innovation, learning, succession, and accountability.

**AMT Expansion Playbook**

Create and maintain the AMT expansion playbook covering organizational, people, technical, process, specification, vendor, equipment, installation, qualification, training, and readiness requirements.

Own the AMT workstream for expansion programs and ensure equipment and technology readiness at each stage gate.

**Nature and Scope**

The Senior Manager leads the global AMT organization with broad accountability for organizational capability, global capital-process stewardship, key vendor relationships, the technical-equipment vendor portfolio, technology investment execution, deployment, and measurable business outcomes across regions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree preferred.

12+ years in manufacturing technology, automation, industrialization, or related fields.

5+ years leading technical teams and complex cross-functional programs.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

Manufacturing technologies, automation, controls, robotics, digital manufacturing, industrialization, equipment-vendor management, capital governance, and portfolio management.

Strong working knowledge of Lean and high-variation, low-volume manufacturing.

**Leadership & Business Competencies**

Compelling vision, stakeholder mobilization, financial acumen, talent development, change leadership, and three-to-five-year strategic planning.

**Working Conditions**

Office and manufacturing environments.

Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds.

Domestic and international travel up to 30 percent.

BAC offers a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401k, employee stock ownership plan, and more. Please see additional details on the BAC website at www.Baltimoreaircoil.com. 
 
BAC Employees are eligible to participate in an annual bonus incentive program.

**Lead Operations. Build Teams. Drive Growth.**

Are you a hands-on operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, improving processes, and delivering results? UFP Factory Built is looking for a Plant Manager to lead one of our manufacturing facilities and play a key role in the success of our growing business.

 

As a Plant Manager, you'll have the opportunity to run the operation like it's your own, leading production, safety, quality, inventory, maintenance, and team development while making a direct impact on profitability and customer satisfaction. This is an ideal role for a leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**About UFP Factory Built**

UFP Factory Built, a division of UFP Industries, supplies structural components and engineered solutions for manufactured housing, modular construction, RV, and cargo trailer manufacturers throughout North America. We are part of a stable, growth-oriented organization with a strong reputation for investing in our people and promoting from within.

 

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and profitability goals are achieved.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of supervisors and production employees.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, waste reduction, and efficiency initiatives.
* Manage production scheduling, inventory levels, shipping activities, and resource planning.
* Monitor key performance metrics and take action to improve throughput, quality, and financial results.
* Partner with leadership on capital investments, facility improvements, and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture centered around safety, employee engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA standards, and all applicable regulations.
Oversee maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. 

 

### **What We're Looking For**

* Experience leading manufacturing, production, operations, or industrial teams.
* Proven ability to motivate employees, develop talent, and drive results.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, costs, and operational metrics.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and implement effective solutions.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and process improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Forklift certification or willingness to obtain certification. 

 

### **Why Join UFP?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence all aspects of a manufacturing operation.
* High visibility and direct impact on business performance.
* Stable and growing company with a strong national footprint.
* Collaborative culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.
* Career advancement opportunities within UFP Industries.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. 

 

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you'll build a safe, efficient, and engaged operation, develop future leaders, improve plant performance, and help position the facility for continued growth. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, the support of an experienced leadership team, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business.

 

**If you're a driven operations leader looking to take ownership of a facility, develop teams, and grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Benefits** **currently offered to our employees:**

* Medical Insurance
* Health Savings Account with Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Stock Purchase Program with Employee Discount
* Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Programs and Challenges
Other Supplemental Benefits 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

source.description:
### **Your Impact as a Regional Operations Director**

As a Regional Operations Director, you are a key leader responsible for the success and health of a diverse portfolio of veterinary hospitals. You will serve as the crucial link between local hospital teams and the broader Mission Pet Health network, empowering your teams to achieve excellence in both business performance and patient care.

* **Champion a Thriving Culture:** You'll partner with your Regional Medical Director to foster a positive, engaged, and high-performing culture across all hospitals in your region.
* **Develop Future Leaders:** You'll guide the growth of Hospital Managers and their teams, ensuring a strong pipeline of talent through effective coaching, training, and career development.
* **Drive Business Performance:** You'll have full ownership of the financial health of your region, managing P&Ls to drive revenue growth and optimize operational efficiency.
* **Build Winning Teams:** You'll lead the strategy for non-DVM recruiting and staffing, ensuring your hospitals have the talent they need to succeed.
* **Elevate the Client Experience:** You'll set the standard for exceptional client service, ensuring operational processes support a seamless and positive experience for every pet owner.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A proven track record of successful multi-site P&L management, with a keen ability to drive financial results.
* Demonstrated success in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams, especially in a leadership capacity.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a talent for building a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused culture.
* Excellent communication and conflict management skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences.
* Significant experience leading in a multi-site veterinary, healthcare, or customer-centric retail environment.

### **How You're Supported**

*As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.* 
 
*Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.*

##### **Competitive Compensation**

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.

##### **Health & Wellbeing**

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.

##### **Financial Security**

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.

##### **Commitment to Growth**

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.

##### **The Power of a Network**

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.

##### **Valuable Perks**

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

### **About Mission Pet Health**

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at **missionpethealth.com**.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – **Work Together, Amaze, and Grow**. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation. Please contact benefits@mvetpartners.com with your request and contact information.

**EEO Statement:** Mission Pet Health is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

source.title: Deputy Head of Production, Connected Warfare
source.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE SITE 

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1 , its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.



 ABOUT THE TEAM

 The Connected Warfare will set the standard for building the future at Arsenal-1 , our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Ashville, OH. This team will have the opportunity to train under our world-class manufacturing team at Anduril HQ in Costa Mesa, CA for 3 months before bringing that standard of excellence back to Ohio.

 ABOUT THE ROLE 

 As the Connected Warfare Deputy Head of Production, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of defense manufacturing by directly influencing the production of Anduril’s Connected Warfare product line. Working as a right hand to the Head of Production, you will own the short-to-mid-term strategic development and execution of manufacturing operations, driving products from NPI to full-rate production. This role requires a dynamic leader who can serve as both a strategic architect and a hands-on executor, leading cross-functional teams to meet aggressive timelines and deliver products of the highest quality for our customers. You will contribute significantly to Anduril’s vision of becoming a next-generation aerospace and defense manufacturer.

 

 What You'll Do: 

 
 Production Ownership & Strategy: Own all production outcomes for the Connected Warfare product line, including ramp plans, headcount, and the standing up of new manufacturing lines. Develop and execute a strategy to rapidly scale production volumes f rom NPI to full-rate production.

 Leadership & Team Management: Serve as a strategic leader and tactical do-er, driving all people and resources across production to achieve outcomes. Lead cross-functional teams (including Production, Supply Chain, Quality, and Manufacturing Engineering) through strong leadership, advocacy, and a consistent on-site presence, holding them accountable to meeting demands, deadlines, and goals.

 Operational Excellence: Drive processes and systems needed throughout the product development lifecycle to mature products to full-rate production. Establish and manage the team to key performance indicators (KPIs) for financial, quality, and on-time delivery, and partner on production budgets and cost targets to optimize manufacturing operations’ impact on the business.

 Quality & Compliance: Be accountable to AS9100D guidelines and drive a “quality-first” culture across all manufacturing operations.

 Process & Technology Advancement: Advise on development and oversee the implementation of digital technologies, from PLM and ERP to our custom MES and QMS systems, that enable our production operations to efficiently scale while meeting customer requirements. Shape corporate tools and processes to support the unique needs of aerospace production.

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 8+ years of proven experience overseeing the production and test of complex electromechanical products.

 Strong leadership experience managing large (100+ person) manufacturing teams and directing large cross-functional teams across planning, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, quality, and production to deliver products of the highest quality.

 A strong background in quality assurance, with a track record of driving a "quality-first" culture in a production environment and accountability to standards like AS9100D.

 Past success operating in both low-rate prototype and high-rate manufacturing environments, with a proven ability to scale production.

 High ownership and the ability to effectively manage multiple large projects and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

 Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

 Ability to work onsite five days a week at our Asheville, OH campus (Arsenal 1).

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 
 Success scaling production operations in a high-complexity manufacturing environment.

 Deep experience with the niche supply chains for aerospace and robotics.

 Demonstrated experience implementing and leveraging digital manufacturing technologies (PLM, ERP, MES, QMS) to drive efficiency and scale.

 
  
 US Salary Range
 $190,000 — $252,000 USD 


 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:   

  

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.  For more information, Explore Our Benefits . 

  

 
 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



 
 To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

 
 
 No Financial Requests:  Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.



 Please always verify communications: 
 
 Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

 Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . 

 


 
 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:  If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.



 
 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:  Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to  contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.



 


  

 Data Privacy 

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

source.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Director - Plant Manager executes the business strategy focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale of the Camden, South Carolina water heater plant. The Plant Manager will work to continuously improve the organization as well as standardize where possible with other facilities in the appliance business. Additionally, this role collaborates closely with Product Management, Technology, Sourcing, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Central Quality to develop and execute NPI (new product introduction) strategies.

**Position**
------------

Senior Director, Plant Management

**Location**
------------

USA, Camden, SC

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

The Senior Director - Plant Manager executes the business strategy focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale of the Camden, South Carolina water heater plant. The Plant Manager will work to continuously improve the organization as well as standardize where possible with other facilities in the appliance business. Additionally, this role collaborates closely with Product Management, Technology, Sourcing, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering and Central Quality to develop and execute NPI (new product introduction) strategies.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

**Minimum Requirements:**

* BS in either Engineering, Operations Management or Supply Chain
* 15+ years of leadership experience in a Manufacturing environment
* Background and demonstrated technical depth in assembly operations and metal fabrication
* Demonstrated ability to drive change and cultural transformation
* Excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated operational leadership abilities and strong communication/change management skills
* Strong business and financial acumen to include critical daily KPI management
* Demonstrated organizational savvy to work cross-functionally to deliver the desired business results
* Appliance, automotive or consumer goods experience gained in a high volume, short cycle, manufacturing environment
* Strong Lean experience with a history of driving a continuous improvement culture
* Demonstrated ability to work and lead collaboratively in a dynamic environment with both salaried and hourly personnel to deliver business financial objectives, NPI program launches and ultimately meet the needs of our customers

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MS or MBA preferred

source.description:
TOGETHER, WE SAVE LIVES
 
 
Summary
 
The Operations Director is responsible for developing and executing the operations strategy for the Jacksonville body armor manufacturing facility. This role provides site leadership across manufacturing operations, manufacturing engineering, maintenance, continuous improvement, and operational excellence to ensure safe, efficient, and scalable execution aligned with company objectives.
 
The Operations Director serves as a champion of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and the Cadre Operating Model, driving a culture of continuous improvement while building organizational structures, leadership capability, and operational systems that support growth and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Develop and execute the operations strategy to support facility performance, growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
* Lead manufacturing operations and manufacturing engineering functions to achieve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and productivity objectives.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Engineering, Product Development, Customer Service, Quality, and HR to align operational capabilities with business priorities.
* Establish performance goals, KPIs, and accountability systems that drive results across the organization.
* Lead capacity planning, labor planning, capital investment, and operational readiness for growth, new products, and facility expansion.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and structured problem solving methodologies to improve operational performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on throughput, quality, lead time reduction, waste elimination, labor efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Provide strategic oversight of automation, process improvement, manufacturing technology, and capital projects to enhance operational capability and scalability.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, regulatory, customer, and environmental requirements while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational design.
* Manage operational budgets and business performance through data-driven decision making, operational reviews, and corrective action planning.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Education
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.

Experience
 

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years leading managers and multi-functional operational organizations.
* Proven experience leading manufacturing operations in a complex, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated success implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Operational Excellence systems.
* Strong experience leading organizational transformation, culture change, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing manufacturing engineering, automation, capital projects, and process improvement programs.
* Background in ballistic armor, protective equipment, defense, aerospace, composites, or similarly regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
* Experience working within environments requiring strict quality, traceability, regulatory, and customer compliance standards.

Preferred Certifications
 

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.

Key Competencies
 

* Strategic thinker with a strong operational mindset.
* Proven ability to lead through influence and drive cross functional alignment.
* Skilled coach and developer of leaders and teams.
* Builds accountability while fostering a respectful and engaged culture.
* Deep understanding of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of value stream management, operational metrics, and performance systems.
* Strong financial and operational decision making skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, operational capability, and business priorities.
* Experience driving growth while maintaining operational discipline.

Physical & Work Environment
 

* Regular presence on the manufacturing floor.
* Ability to work around industrial equipment, materials, and PPE requirements.
* Occasional travel to other company locations, suppliers, and customers.
* Occasional extended hours or off-shift support based on business needs.

* Paid time off (PTO), sick leave and paid holidays throughout the calendar year (consistent with relevant state law and company policies)

The Safariland Group believes in the benefits of a diverse workforce and is committed to equal opportunity and affirmative actions. We pride ourselves on hiring and developing the best people, without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic characteristics, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, alienage, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally recognized protected basis prohibited by applicable law.
